title: Decision: No unwrap() in production paths ensures graceful degradation
description: Scanning the entire file: no .unwrap(), .expect(), or ! panics in production code. Certificate parsing (line 74) returns Result. Stream operations (line 195) propagate with ?. Channel sends (line 204) check .is_err(). This disciplined error handling means network failures, malformed responses, or dropped channels cannot crash kith-tui. Errors are logged or handled explicitly.
